SQL: SELECT v.year, v.semester, v.code, CASE WHEN lower(v.code) LIKE '%x%' AND v.note IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN v.note IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN instr(v.note, ' | ') > 0 THEN substr(v.note, 1, instr(v.note, ' | ') - 1) ELSE v.note END ELSE COALESCE(v.name_th, CASE WHEN v.note IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN instr(v.note, ' | ') > 0 THEN substr(v.note, 1, instr(v.note, ' | ') - 1) ELSE v.note END) END AS name_th, v.credits FROM v_plan AS v WHERE v.year = 1 AND v.semester = 1 ORDER BY v.code LIMIT 200
